Description: Measles infection through transmission/contact.
Receipt of the first measles-containing vaccine dose.
Progression from latent infection to infectiousness.
Recovery from infection with acquisition of immunity.
Receipt of the second measles-containing vaccine dose.

Name: infection rate
Description: Transmission intensity parameter used in the fitted transmission model.

Name: duration of maternal immunity
Description: Average duration of maternally derived protection before susceptibility.

Name: seasonality of transmission
Description: Parameters governing seasonal variation in measles transmission.

Name: importation parameters
Description: Parameters governing imported measles cases and their reporting.

Name: report rate of imported cases
Description: Probability that imported cases are reported.

Name: vaccine effectiveness
Description: Effectiveness of measles vaccination in preventing infection/clinical disease.

Name: existing immunity in older generations
Description: Background immunity among older age groups.

Name: parameters of spatial spread
Description: Parameters describing geographic spread between regions.

Name: waning rate
Description: Rate of waning of vaccine-induced immunity in the sensitivity analysis with waning.

Name: MMR1 coverage increase
Description: Scenario changes in annual first-dose coverage.

Name: MMR2 coverage increase
Description: Scenario changes in annual second-dose coverage.

Name: MMR2 schedule age
Description: Alternative second-dose timing used in simulations instead of 3 years and 4 months.

Name: MMR2 school-entry age
Description: Alternative second-dose timing at school entry.

Name: current MMR2 schedule age
Description: Reference second-dose timing in England.

Name: MMR1 schedule age
Description: Reference first-dose timing in England.
